dct_description_sm: The investigation of a species vocal repertoire and the contexts in which different calls are used is central to understanding vocal communication among animals. The purpose of this study was to describe beluga call types and call characteristics associated with different behaviours in the Churchill River, Manitoba. Information on call types, call characteristics, and behavioural context of calls can be used in developing automated detection and classification methods and in future studies on call meaning and function.
dct_title_s: Beluga whale calls and behaviour in western Hudson Bay (the Churchill River, Manitoba)
